preferences_settings_problem_statement_c.name: preferences_settings_problem_statement_check
preferences_settings_problem_statement_c.value:
(
			("preferences_settings"."problem_statement_object_key" is null
				and "preferences_settings"."problem_statement_original_filename" is null
				and "preferences_settings"."problem_statement_mime_type" is null
				and "preferences_settings"."problem_statement_file_size" is null)
			or
			("preferences_settings"."problem_statement_object_key" is not null
				and "preferences_settings"."problem_statement_original_filename" is not null
				and "preferences_settings"."problem_statement_mime_type" is not null
				and "preferences_settings"."problem_statement_mime_type" = 'application/pdf'
				and "preferences_settings"."problem_statement_file_size" is not null
				and "preferences_settings"."problem_statement_file_size" > 0)
		)

round_1_teams_admission_source_check.name: round_1_teams_admission_source_check
round_1_teams_admission_source_check.value:
(
      ("round_1_teams"."admission_method" = 'cv_screening' and "round_1_teams"."source_round_0_5_team_id" is null) or
      ("round_1_teams"."admission_method" = 'round_0_5_promotion' and "round_1_teams"."source_round_0_5_team_id" is not null)
    )

round_1_teams_preference_state_check.name: round_1_teams_preference_state_check
round_1_teams_preference_state_check.value:
(
      ("round_1_teams"."preference_status" = 'not_submitted' and cardinality("round_1_teams"."preferences") = 0
        and "round_1_teams"."preference_submitted_at" is null and "round_1_teams"."assigned_track_id" is null and "round_1_teams"."assigned_at" is null) or
      ("round_1_teams"."preference_status" = 'submitted' and cardinality("round_1_teams"."preferences") = 3
        and "round_1_teams"."preference_submitted_at" is not null and "round_1_teams"."assigned_track_id" is null and "round_1_teams"."assigned_at" is null) or
      ("round_1_teams"."preference_status" = 'assigned' and cardinality("round_1_teams"."preferences") = 3
        and "round_1_teams"."preference_submitted_at" is not null and "round_1_teams"."assigned_track_id" is not null
        and "round_1_teams"."assigned_track_id" = any("round_1_teams"."preferences") and "round_1_teams"."assigned_at" is not null)
    )

ticket_validity_values.name: ticket_validity_values
ticket_validity_values.value: "admission_tickets"."validity" in ('valid', 'revoked') and "admission_tickets"."category" in ('normal', 'vip') and "admission_tickets"."accepted_count" >= 0 and "admission_tickets"."credential_version" >= 1 and "admission_tickets"."ordinal" >= 1

ticket_source_ownership.name: ticket_source_ownership
ticket_source_ownership.value: ("admission_tickets"."source" = 'purchased' and "admission_tickets"."order_id" is not null and "admission_tickets"."owner_id" is not null and "admission_tickets"."batch_id" is null and "admission_tickets"."sales_log_id" is null) or ("admission_tickets"."source" = 'gifted' and "admission_tickets"."batch_id" is not null and "admission_tickets"."order_id" is null and "admission_tickets"."owner_id" is null and "admission_tickets"."sales_log_id" is null) or ("admission_tickets"."source" = 'sales-log' and "admission_tickets"."sales_log_id" is not null and "admission_tickets"."order_id" is null and "admission_tickets"."owner_id" is null and "admission_tickets"."batch_id" is null)

sales_log_values.name: sales_log_values
sales_log_values.value: "ticket_sales_logs"."quantity" between 1 and 100 and "ticket_sales_logs"."amount_received" between 0 and 2000000000 and "ticket_sales_logs"."category" in ('normal', 'vip') and "ticket_sales_logs"."email_status" in ('pending', 'sending', 'sent', 'failed') and "ticket_sales_logs"."buyer_name" ~ '[^[:space:]]' and "ticket_sales_logs"."buyer_phone" ~ '[^[:space:]]'

sales_log_proof_shape.name: sales_log_proof_shape
sales_log_proof_shape.value: ("ticket_sales_logs"."proof_upload_id" is null and "ticket_sales_logs"."proof_object_key" is null and "ticket_sales_logs"."proof_filename" is null) or ("ticket_sales_logs"."proof_upload_id" is not null and "ticket_sales_logs"."proof_object_key" is not null and "ticket_sales_logs"."proof_filename" is not null)

ticket_order_promo_reservation.name: ticket_order_promo_reservation
ticket_order_promo_reservation.value: ("ticket_orders"."promo_id" is null and "ticket_orders"."promo_reservation" = 'none') or ("ticket_orders"."promo_id" is not null and "ticket_orders"."promo_reservation" in ('held', 'consumed', 'released') and "ticket_orders"."snapshot"->'promo' is not null)

ticket_order_snapshot_shape.name: ticket_order_snapshot_shape
ticket_order_snapshot_shape.value: "ticket_orders"."snapshot"->>'currency' = 'VND' and (("ticket_orders"."snapshot"->>'totalPrice')::integer > 0 or (("ticket_orders"."snapshot"->>'totalPrice')::integer = 0 and "ticket_orders"."promo_id" is not null)) and (("ticket_orders"."snapshot"->>'packageName' = 'Silver' and "ticket_orders"."snapshot"->>'category' = 'normal' and ("ticket_orders"."snapshot"->>'quantity')::integer = 1) or ("ticket_orders"."snapshot"->>'packageName' = 'Golden' and "ticket_orders"."snapshot"->>'category' = 'normal' and ("ticket_orders"."snapshot"->>'quantity')::integer = 2) or ("ticket_orders"."snapshot"->>'packageName' = 'Platinum' and "ticket_orders"."snapshot"->>'category' = 'normal' and ("ticket_orders"."snapshot"->>'quantity')::integer = 3) or ("ticket_orders"."snapshot"->>'packageName' = 'VIP' and "ticket_orders"."snapshot"->>'category' = 'vip' and ("ticket_orders"."snapshot"->>'quantity')::integer = 1))

ticket_package_shape.name: ticket_package_shape
ticket_package_shape.value: ("ticket_packages"."name" = 'Silver' and "ticket_packages"."quantity" = 1 and "ticket_packages"."category" = 'normal') or ("ticket_packages"."name" = 'Golden' and "ticket_packages"."quantity" = 2 and "ticket_packages"."category" = 'normal') or ("ticket_packages"."name" = 'Platinum' and "ticket_packages"."quantity" = 3 and "ticket_packages"."category" = 'normal') or ("ticket_packages"."name" = 'VIP' and "ticket_packages"."quantity" = 1 and "ticket_packages"."category" = 'vip')

ticket_promo_limits.name: ticket_promo_limits
ticket_promo_limits.value: ("ticket_promos"."total_limit" is null or "ticket_promos"."total_limit" > 0) and ("ticket_promos"."per_buyer_limit" is null or "ticket_promos"."per_buyer_limit" > 0)

ticket_promo_prices.name: ticket_promo_prices
ticket_promo_prices.value: jsonb_typeof("ticket_promos"."prices") = 'object' and "ticket_promos"."prices" ?& array['Silver', 'Golden', 'Platinum', 'VIP'] and jsonb_typeof("ticket_promos"."prices"->'Silver') = 'number' and (("ticket_promos"."prices"->>'Silver')::numeric = 0 or ("ticket_promos"."prices"->>'Silver')::numeric between 1000 and 1000000000) and ("ticket_promos"."prices"->>'Silver')::numeric = trunc(("ticket_promos"."prices"->>'Silver')::numeric) and jsonb_typeof("ticket_promos"."prices"->'Golden') = 'number' and (("ticket_promos"."prices"->>'Golden')::numeric = 0 or ("ticket_promos"."prices"->>'Golden')::numeric between 1000 and 1000000000) and ("ticket_promos"."prices"->>'Golden')::numeric = trunc(("ticket_promos"."prices"->>'Golden')::numeric) and jsonb_typeof("ticket_promos"."prices"->'Platinum') = 'number' and (("ticket_promos"."prices"->>'Platinum')::numeric = 0 or ("ticket_promos"."prices"->>'Platinum')::numeric between 1000 and 1000000000) and ("ticket_promos"."prices"->>'Platinum')::numeric = trunc(("ticket_promos"."prices"->>'Platinum')::numeric) and jsonb_typeof("ticket_promos"."prices"->'VIP') = 'number' and (("ticket_promos"."prices"->>'VIP')::numeric = 0 or ("ticket_promos"."prices"->>'VIP')::numeric between 1000 and 1000000000) and ("ticket_promos"."prices"->>'VIP')::numeric = trunc(("ticket_promos"."prices"->>'VIP')::numeric)
